heading: INT. REGIONAL SOCK WAREHOUSE - RETURNS CAGE - DAY

units.text: INT. REGIONAL SOCK WAREHOUSE - RETURNS CAGE - DAY
KWABENA OSEI-BONSU (40s, lanyard, three pens) glares at a pallet of mismatched socks.
BRENDA TUCKWELL (50s, headset) and her intern PRIYA NAIR (20s, hoodie) hover.
Every single one is a left foot.
units.name: KWABENA

units.text: Brenda, this is the Q3 initiative.
units.name: KWABENA

units.text: And she wrote the memo. She also approved the vendor. She also, apparently, ordered only lefts.
units.name: KWABENA

units.text: I approved a vendor. He ordered the lefts.
units.name: BRENDA

units.text: So he's the problem, then? He shipped what she approved.
units.name: PRIYA

units.text: Priya, he did not write the memo, she did.
units.name: KWABENA

units.text: He rewrote my memo, actually. I wrote "pairs."
units.name: BRENDA

units.text: He wrote "pair." Singular. One pair of socks.
units.name: PRIYA

units.text: Fine. Fine. Then we ship one pair to every customer and call it exclusive.
units.name: KWABENA

units.text: I'll put that in the deck.
units.name: BRENDA

units.text: I'll put it in the apology.
units.name: PRIYA
